description: Search mothermachine.ai, a directory of software an agent can adapt (pull the source and configure it) or operate (drive it through an MCP server, API, CLI, or config). Give one thing the software must do, in a word or two ("booking", "invoicing"), the commercial product to replace ("replace Calendly"), or the kind of business the user runs ("barbershop software"). A need with two parts is two calls. Returns ranked listings with the repo, how much is yours to change, how an agent reaches it, the license, and links to the page and JSON record. A query that names a kind of business also returns its stack: the page that names the listing for each job that business needs and how the apps hand work to each other. With a filter set, each of its jobs says whether its listing fits the filter. Empty query with a filter lists a whole slice.

adaptable.description: Only listings whose source is public with a named surface to change.

effort.description: How much work it is to make it yours.

interface.description: Only listings an agent drives through this interface kind. mcp also includes listings whose builder ships an MCP server beside another interface.

open.description: Only open source listings by the site's rule: an open license, no source-available or Commons Clause terms, and no closed core.

operability.description: How an agent drives it; vocab lists the values (native, official, wrapped, config, gui).

operable.description: Only listings an agent can operate through an interface.

query.description: One need in a word or two ("booking"), or a product name. Not the user's whole sentence. May be empty when a filter is set.

vertical.description: Restrict to one vertical; vocab lists the values.

name: search
